patches.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches.description: Offers Stock, Chat Heads and Native Bubbles on verified Messenger routes on Android 11 and newer. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you screenshot photos, media and video Messenger protects in a chat, and stops screenshot notices. View-once media stays protected. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches.description: Hides the generated-sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches.description: Hides the Chat Moments entry in the menu. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches.description: Hides Facebook toolbar, profile and sharing shortcuts, and Also from Meta in the Menu tab. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Hides the floating button, toolbar button, Meta AI tab, menu entries and search AI. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide People You May Know
patches.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Reels badge
patches.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches.description: Hides suggested replies in business conversations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides business suggestions as you type. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide chat promotions
patches.description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners inside conversations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide event prompts
patches.description: Hides event quick-promotion prompts inside chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide friend request cards
patches.description: Hides friend request cards inside the inbox. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide growth prompts
patches.description: Hides the inbox's add-more-people promotion unit. Also hides the tip sheets in notes, like Make my notes public, and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox ads
patches.description: Filters typed inbox ad items, in case Meta brings back the inbox ads it stopped selling in November 2025. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches.description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners in the chat list. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches.description: Hides the Home and Channels subtabs. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: Suppresses your outgoing read receipt. In end-to-end encrypted chats, chats you open stay unread until you reply. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide stories and notes
patches.description: Hides the horizontal tray above chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Suppresses your outgoing active-typing signal, including in end-to-end encrypted chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches.description: Renames two shared permissions so a re-signed Messenger can install beside Meta apps. Checked 580 builds only. Earlier clean installs stopped at a blank first-run screen.

patches.name: Keep unsent messages
patches.description: Preserves messages on verified legacy unsend routes. End-to-end encrypted chats are unsupported, and group coverage is unverified. Activity records intercepted legacy unsends, not chat support. Your own unsend may be limited. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Gives Messenger's dark mode the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first.

patches.name: Open settings from menu
patches.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to the Menu tab and side menu. Always on.

patches.name: Open web links externally
patches.description: Uses Messenger's external-browser branch for HTTP and HTTPS links. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Answers Messenger's own signer lookup, and a Facebook signed with your key calling Messenger, with the original Meta certificate. Always on.

patches.name: Save any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories. The photo or video goes to your phone the same way Messenger saves your own. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Send photos at original quality
patches.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo's own image data instead of a re-encoded copy, without its metadata except the rotation tag. Videos and photos over 20 MB are still compressed. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Slide chats in and out
patches.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back, while the screen underneath holds still. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Use system emoji
patches.description: Renders emoji with the phone's own font instead of Messenger's. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Stories you open this way are marked as seen on your side. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
